verification.realNetworkMethod: Two independent Node HTTP clients with separate sessions and actual SSE streams on loopback. Join, movement, shots/damage, round/rematch, disconnect/rejoin and access checks.
verification.browserMethod: Two Chromium contexts via set_content with MOCKED fetch/EventSource/sessionStorage. Exact application source, DOM controls, synthetic controller and server-state replay. No administrator browser restrictions bypassed.
verification.recoveryTest: restore_08l.py verified the package SHA and per-file hashes, restored all 168 files into a new directory, then npm test passed all 19 Node subtests. No dependency installation required.

capture.method: Actual browser screenshots replaying captured server states, with documentary labels. Not live browser networking, human play or a performance benchmark.

storageBoundary: GitHub stores selected duel/server source, slide guard, exact package restore script, report and receipts. The complete client/server code, all images, tests, launchers and evidence are in the verified package and Library. The repository subset alone is not a complete deployable game. No new Vercel deployment.
remaining: Native browser-to-server test, two actual computers, private HTTPS hosting, latency and feel validation. Final Jade still has only three source poses for one supported corner view; authored motion and full directional coverage remain unfinished.
